hook.name: Sa1tHook
hook.description: A multi-phase token launch hook managing CURVE (bonding curve with custom pricing via ERC-6909 claims), REFUND_WINDOW (sell-only with refunds at entry price), and AMM (full-range Uniswap v4 pool with 1% fee skim) phases. Supports mechanic plugins for customizable fee structures and behaviors (e.g., HALVING token burns, MONEYBACK refunds).
